legal_basis: Where GDPR applies, the developer relies on legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f) for minimal aggregate usage measurement and service security: understanding which game functions work and maintaining the service. Counters are limited, expire, contain no player/device identifiers and are not used to profile, advertise to or make decisions about a child. Offline play does not require analytics. Continue acknowledges the notice; it is not consent. You may object through Privacy rights, which suspends collection while the request is handled. Applicable rights and any legal requirement for consent take precedence. Optional publication requires a separate adult-managed decision and explicit sharing; legitimate interests support safe operation, moderation and withdrawal of that requested feature. Support and privacy correspondence are processed to answer requests and meet applicable legal obligations.
provider_practices: The developer has confirmed that Cloudflare is used only for Tunnel/proxy routing and protection for stats.clemir.com; Cloudflare Web Analytics, Logpush and other optional collection services are not enabled. Cloudflare necessarily processes IP addresses and connection/security information and may retain service data under its own published terms and privacy policy. Its role varies by data category, including processor for customer content and controller for some service data. Our collector does not retain raw request, IP or user-agent logs. We do not claim Cloudflare retains no logs or that its service-data retention equals our 90-day aggregate retention. No advertising, analytics SDK or third-party marketing tracker is embedded in the app.
children_practices: Scorer World includes children and teenagers in its audience. Public records are locked by default. An adult must complete a local adult-age declaration and configure/unlock a PIN before sharing; the date of birth is checked locally and discarded, never transmitted. This is a local access safeguard, not verified parental identity or proof of parental consent. An adult should supervise the decision and use pseudonyms, never a child’s full name, school or contact details. Sharing requires community rules and an explicit action; submissions await moderation. Reports, blocking, withdrawal and support are available. Minimal automatic counters do not identify individual children, and the privacy-request suspension also applies to children or requests made by their authorised guardian. We do not collect location, contacts, advertising IDs or behavioural profiles.
international_transfers: The developer operates the collector; Cloudflare routes traffic through an international network and may process connection data outside your country, including outside the EEA. EU-only residency is not promised. Cloudflare publishes a Data Processing Addendum and information about European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses and, where applicable to the relevant entities and transfers, Data Privacy Framework participation. These mechanisms apply according to the provider’s actual terms and applicable law; this policy does not claim an individual account audit or a separately verified contract. See the official provider references below and contact the developer about applicable safeguards.
